- No criminalisation of same-sex conduct; no anti-trans statute; no arrest pattern; no police targeting documented.

- Day-to-day rejection documented (hostile messages to organiser's family).
- Partnership recognition closed — civil code marriage only different-sex; visitor partner no recognition. That's tangential for a lone traveller but relevant for travelling with a partner; domestic violence law covers analogous spouses regardless of gender.
- Border: no documented screening practice; document marker practice not documented. Absence of evidence not safety, but also not an exposure. Rule 13: open questions are light.
